description: Sample payloads for the ledger source mappers in packages/ledger/src/sources. All values are invented and reuse the sessions in claude-code/ and codex/.

files.shape: OTLP JSON ExportLogsServiceRequest, as the OpenTelemetry collector file exporter writes it.
files.fieldsFrom: Claude Code monitoring docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage): claude_code.* event names, standard attributes (session.id, user.email, organization.id, app.version, prompt.id, event.sequence) and per-event attributes.
files.description: Claude Code 2.1.309 events for session a20d0d4b on 2026-10-06: user_prompt without prompt text, api_request with tokens and cost_usd, tool_decision accepted by config and rejected by the user, a failing Bash tool_result, an api_error 529, and an mcp_server_connection event the mapper skips.

files.shape: One LiteLLM StandardLoggingPayload per line, as its logging callbacks emit it, with user agent tagging on and message bodies redacted.
files.description: A Claude Code request through Bedrock for session 538b2156 (a session the compliance feed does not cover), a Codex request through OpenAI for thread 01a10ca6, and a throttled Bedrock request that failed.

files.shape: One page of an Anthropic Compliance API style activity feed ({ data, has_more }).
files.description: Claude Code activity for session 665bce74 on 2026-10-05 (start, prompt, a permission decision, usage, end) and a claude.ai chat activity the mapper skips.

notes: The compliance activity field names are a best guess until real samples arrive (see Needs under F01 in the build plan). Only the mapper in vendor-audit.ts depends on them.
LiteLLM prompt_tokens includes cache reads and writes; the mapper subtracts them to get uncached input tokens.
